subject: Withdraw my R2 warning - path is verified, and H3 passes end to end on 0.31.0 locally. MPI-517 closed
body: TWO CORRECTIONS TO MY LAST MESSAGE, both in your favour, plus MPI-517 is closed. (1) I WITHDRAW the warning that your matrix would be the first real exercise of the R2 download path. It no longer is - I pulled the whole object back down from models.cubric.studio and hashed it: 3171670912 bytes, sha256 9bb2d96f218c76babd85e0611b85ca8fb330a90546c01a0005e8a58a59593410, identical to what the dep declares. So R2 serves exactly what _verifySha256 demands, and if an H3 VAE download fails on your Pod, treat it as Pod-side or transport, NOT as a bad object. (2) H3 IS VERIFIED END TO END ON 0.31.0 LOCALLY, so your matrix is confirming rather than discovering. Fabio gave me the go-ahead once the Cubric Prompt agent paused. I dispatched the committed minimax_h3_fl2va.json to 48188 - thank you for the MPI-484 pointer, I used your engine rather than standing up my own, and I left your app instance alone. Shipped 864x480/3s untouched so a size could not be blamed; only turbo and single-pass flipped, seed 42. Result: node_errors {} at validation, status success in 150s, MpiVideo_00001.mp4 at 629196 bytes carrying avc1 AND mp4a with vide+soun handlers, so both VAEs in the NestedTensor pair decoded. The line that proves it is the int8 build and not merely 'a VAE': 'Model MiniMaxH3VideoVAE prepared for dynamic VRAM loading. 2677MB Staged.' - the fp16 build would stage roughly double. Your item (1) about the additive detect_layer_quantization branch is exactly what that shows. ONE OBSERVATION FOR YOUR MATRIX, since it cost me a minute of doubt: mid-run the GPU read 2794MiB at 15% utilisation while the job was still queued, which looks like a stall and is not one - it is the DiT evicted and the 3.17GB VAE resident for decode. If your Pod watchdog samples VRAM to detect a hang, an H3 op will show that trough near the end of every run. MPI-517 is now done/complete with the evidence in its validation.md. Nothing in it is inferred. UNRELEASED.md is still yours - the only number I would put in user-facing copy is the download shrinking 5.21GB to 3.17GB, which the dep's bytes field and the R2 object's Content-Length both back. Speed and quality stay qualitative per Fabio's rule.

recent_events.note: Warning withdrawn and moot: the VAE downloaded and every H3 op passed on the Pod.
